jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer, Continuous Improvement

City

Irving

State/Province

Texas

Overview:

The Principal Engineer, Continuous Improvement enjoys data mining, identifying improvement opportunities, leading teams to identify root cause and implement and sustaining improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Lead projects of cross functional global teams through the DMAIC cycle to identify non-value added steps and waste in the process and identify and evaluate opportunities for improvement.
- Help manage company productivity program and support sites in achieving their yearly goals.
- Drive a culture of data-based decision making in both transactional and manufacturing processes.
- Analyze data to discover trends and issues and identify predictive and preventative actions to improve reliability and reduce variation in a process.
- Help establish a structure and culture of continuous improvement across the global corporation
- Provide training on data analysis, lean and Six Sigma tools.
- Implement a structure to sustain improvements and embed the new processes into the current workflow.
- Lead and assists in defining, setting and implementation performance improvement strategies at locations.
- Collaborate with and influence senior management on areas of improvement and translate mgmt. expectations into project deliverables.
- Assist and lead digitalization and automation efforts globally that will assist in predictive maintenance etc.
- Drive the standardization, implementation and communication of organizational best practices
- Drive the implementation of Organizational Management at sites and the implementation of Leading and Lagging KPIs.

Qualifications:

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
- Lean Manufacturing training and implementation of Lean Tools in both Manufacturing and Transactional environments
- Lean Six Sigma training and certification (Green Belt, preferred Black Belt, Master Black Belt, or Lean Master Black Belt)
- Strong statistical background and skilled at data analysis
- Working knowledge of MiniTab (SAP and Power BI preferred)
- Ability to interface and collaborate with senior mgmt. on opportunities and project status

- Broad and deep knowledge of Quality theories/tools that can be implemented in a Chemical Industry
- Ownership mentality, passionate about improving our processes and cost efficiency
- Strong interpersonal written and verbal communication skills to communicate within the team and with customers

Required Years’ Experience:
- 10+ years of work experience in a manufacturing environment practicing Lean Six Sigma tools and Data Analysis

Required Education:
- A Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline

Travel Requirements:
- Domestic and International travel. 25-50% of time

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Treasury Analyst

City

Irving

State/Province

Texas

Overview:

Location - Irving, TX - Hybrid - 3 days in office, 2 remote
Celanese is seeking a Senior Treasury Analyst to join our Capital Markets team. This role supports the company’s funding, liquidity, and balance sheet strategy through capital markets execution, financial modeling, debt portfolio management, and treasury reporting. The position partners closely with Treasury, FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and external banking partners to deliver high-quality analysis and execution support for debt and capital markets activities.

Responsibilities:

Capital Markets & Debt Management
- Assist in executing capital markets transactions, including debt issuances and refinancing, swap transactions, through financial modeling, preparation of presentation materials, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
- Support ongoing debt portfolio management by assisting with KYC requirements, audits, compliance reporting, and recurring monthly reporting activities.

Financial Modeling
- Maintain and enhance treasury models used for interest expense forecasting, liquidity planning and scenario analysis.
- Evaluate and validate credit rating agency models on a quarterly basis to ensure alignment with the company’s credit rating strategy.
- Partner with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and business teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and improve forecast accuracy and reporting quality.

Reporting & Month‑End Close
- Support month‑end and quarter‑end close processes for treasury, including debt valuation reports, treasury support packages, journal entry preparation/backup and account reconciliations in collaboration with Accounting.

- Prepared board-level and executive presentation materials, including rating agency decks and market updates.

- Enhanced treasury reporting processes to improve data accuracy and deliver actionable insights.

Compliance & Controls
- Support SOX compliance requirements and respond to internal and external audit requests, including securitization audits, with accurate and timely documentation.
- Prepare and maintain treasury compliance reports and ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
- 2–3 years of experience in corporate treasury, capital markets, corporate finance, banking, or FP&A, with direct exposure to financial modeling and reporting.
- Strong financial modeling capabilities: advanced Excel skills required. Experience with SAP is a plus.
- Solid understanding of debt instruments, interest calculations, and basic covenant structures.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.

jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager – Industrial Services & Projects
jobs.description:
Procurement Category Manager – Industrial Services & Projects

City

Pasadena

State/Province

Texas

Overview:

Celanese is seeking a Procurement Category Manager – Industrial Services & Projects (Manager, MRO/Indirect) experienced in developing and executing category strategies and preparing, negotiating, managing, and coordinating agreements for Industrial and Technical Services across Celanese manufacturing facilities in the Americas. This role leads supplier relationship management initiatives and collaborates with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Capital Projects, Environmental, and Functional stakeholders to deliver procurement and value creation strategies.

The Category Manager is responsible for sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and commercial support for a diverse portfolio of service categories including maintenance, construction, environmental services, specialized crafts, and project-related services. The position identifies and drives continuous improvement opportunities, oversees contract implementation and supplier performance, and serves as a strategic business partner supporting both day-to-day manufacturing operations and capital investment initiatives.
This position can be located in either Pasadena, Texas or in Irving, Texas.

Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement category strategies for Industrial and Technical Services across the Americas region.
- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives, competitive bidding events, and supplier negotiations for maintenance, construction, environmental, and project-related services.
- Build strong partnerships with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, EHS, and Capital Project stakeholders to understand business requirements and develop procurement solutions.
- Negotiate and administer complex service agreements, master service agreements, project contracts, and related commercial terms and conditions.
- Lead supplier relationship management activities including performance reviews, scorecards, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Drive value creation through cost optimization, process improvements, supplier innovation, and risk mitigation.
- Support capital projects by providing sourcing strategy, commercial negotiation, contract development, and supplier management expertise.
- Ensure suppliers meet safety, compliance, sustainability, and operational performance expectations.
- Identify opportunities to standardize services, leverage spend, and improve total cost of ownership across manufacturing sites.
- Resolve commercial and supplier performance issues while maintaining productive business relationships.
- Utilize procurement systems, sourcing tools, market intelligence, and data analytics to support decision-making and category management activities.
- Collaborate with Procurement leadership and category peers to support broader procurement initiatives and organizational objectives.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
- 7–15 years of professional experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction Management, Operations, Maintenance, or related industrial fields.
- Demonstrated experience negotiating contracts and managing supplier relationships.
- Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, chemical, energy, or heavy industrial operations preferred.
- Experience supporting capital projects, construction projects, maintenance programs, or engineering services strongly preferred.
- Strong understanding of legal, commercial, and risk management concepts within service agreements.
- Project management experience preferred.
- CPSM, CPSD, PMP, C.P.M., or similar professional certification preferred.

Preferred Category Experience
- Maintenance Services
- Mechanical, Electrical, and Instrumentation Services
- Environmental Services
- Waste Management
- Specialized Craft Services
- Industrial Construction
- Turnaround and Outage Services
- Engineering Services
- Capital Project Support Services
- Industrial Facility Services
- Technical Consulting Services

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities
- Strategic sourcing and category management expertise.
- Strong commercial and contract negotiation skills.
- Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.
- Excellent communication and relationship management capabilities.
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities across geographically dispersed manufacturing locations.
- Demonstrated problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset.
- Strong financial acumen and understanding of total cost of ownership concepts.
- High ethical standards and commitment to safety, compliance, and responsible sourcing.

Key Personal Qualities
- Strategic thinker who can balance long-term value creation with day-to-day business support.
- Self-starter who thrives in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Strong collaborator capable of building credibility with technical and operational stakeholders.
- Results-oriented with a bias for action and accountability.
- Comfortable working independently while leading cross-functional initiatives.
- Naturally curious and willing to learn new categories and business processes.

jobs.title: Finance Intern (Graduate - MBA)
jobs.description:
Finance Intern (Graduate - MBA)

Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated MBA (Graduate) Finance Intern to join our Finance organization for a strategic summer internship experience. This role provides MBA candidates with exposure to corporate finance, financial planning and analysis, business strategy, forecasting, and executive decision support. The intern will lead a high-impact project while partnering with cross-functional business leaders to develop actionable insights that drive business performance.

Responsibilities:

Please note, we are hiring for this role in Irving, TX
- Support financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis activities.
- Evaluate financial and operational performance to identify opportunities, risks, and key business drivers.
- Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic initiatives.
- Conduct trend analysis and generate insights from large, complex datasets.
- Assist in preparing executive-level dashboards, presentations, and management reports.
- Leverage AI-enabled tools and advanced analytics to improve forecasting accuracy and business insight generation.
- Analyze actual versus budget and forecast results and recommend corrective actions.
- Support long-range planning and strategic decision-making through financial and operational analysis.
- Partner with Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, and Accounting teams to understand business challenges and identify value creation opportunities.
- Lead an internship project focused on business performance, process improvement, digital transformation, or financial optimization.
- Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve forecasting processes, and enhance data quality.
- Present project findings and recommendations to senior Finance leadership at the conclusion of the internship.

Qualifications:

- Currently pursuing a Master's in Business Administration (MBA), Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in using data to identify trends, develop forecasts, and solve business challenges.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and financial analysis.
- Experience with or interest in AI-enabled productivity and analytical tools and their application in a corporate Finance environment.
- Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI or similar platforms is preferred.
- Familiarity with forecasting, financial modeling, scenario analysis, and/or predictive analytics is preferred.
- Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies, including generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate data and analysis into clear business recommendations.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Human Resources
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Human Resources

City

Irving

State/Province

Texas

Overview:

The HR M&A Sr Manager leads the people-related aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and joint ventures. This role partners closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, IT, and business leadership to ensure effective HR due diligence, integration planning, TSA and post-close execution. The ideal candidate brings strong HR expertise, project management discipline, and the ability to operate in complex, fast-paced deal environments.

Responsibilities:

Deal Strategy & Due Diligence
- Lead HR due diligence for M&A and divestiture activities, including workforce structure, compensation and benefits, labor relations, policies, compliance, and liabilities.
- Identify people-related risks, cost synergies, and integration considerations; clearly document findings and recommendations.
- Advise deal teams on HR-related transaction risks and mitigation strategies.

Integration & Separation Planning
- Develop and execute HR integration or separation strategies aligned with deal objectives and timelines.
- Lead planning for key HR workstreams, including:
- Organizational structure and workforce transition
- Talent and retention planning
- Compensation, benefits, and payroll alignment
- HR systems, data, and process integration
- Policies, compliance, and employment contracts

- Coordinate Day 1 readiness activities to ensure seamless employee transitions.

Change Management & Communications
- Partner with Communications and Leadership to support change management strategies and employee messaging.
- Support consistent, compliant, and timely employee communications throughout the transaction lifecycle.

Stakeholder Management
- Serve as the primary HR point of contact for M&A-related activities.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, IT, Corporate Development and external advisors.
- Influence senior leaders with data-driven insights and practical solutions.

Governance, Tools & Continuous Improvement
- Establish and maintain HR M&A playbooks, templates, and best practices.
- Track progress against milestones, risks, and dependencies.
- Drive post-integration reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future transactions.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field.
- 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including direct involvement in M&A and divestitures.
- Strong knowledge of core HR disciplines (total rewards, employee relations, payroll and HR operations).
- Proven project management skills in complex, cross-functional environments.
- Experience managing confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA or Master’s degree in HR, Business, or related field.
- Experience supporting global or cross-border transactions.
- Familiarity with employment law considerations across multiple jurisdictions.
- HR certification (SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent).
- Previous experience in a matrixed, multinational organization.

Key Competencies
- Strong execution capability
- Influencing and stakeholder management
- Analytical and financial acumen related to people costs
- Clear, concise communication at all organizational levels
- Ability to thrive amid ambiguity and tight deadlines
